headers.description: headers are the APNs request headers.

payload.description: payload is the APNs payload as JSON. Required.

ApnsPushNotification.description: ApnsPushNotification is a notification for APNs. Centrifugo PRO only.

commands.description: commands to execute. Replies come back in the same order.

parallel.description:
parallel makes Centrifugo process the commands concurrently instead of
one after another. This may reduce latency (especially with the Redis
engine), but gives no ordering guarantee between commands.

BatchRequest.description:
BatchRequest sends many commands in one request, which avoids paying a
round trip per command. Check the error of each reply individually.

replies.description: replies to the commands, in the order of BatchRequest.commands.

BatchResponse.description: BatchResponse contains the replies to a BatchRequest.

expire_at.description:
expire_at is the Unix time in seconds when the block expires. Optional,
but a reasonably small value is recommended to keep the set of blocked
users small.

user.description: user is the ID of the user to block. Required.

BlockUserRequest.description:
BlockUserRequest blocks a user: the user is disconnected and can not
connect again until unblocked or the block expires. Centrifugo PRO only.

error.description: error is set if the call failed.

BlockUserResponse.description:
BlockUserResponse is the response to a BlockUserRequest.
Centrifugo PRO only.

BlockUserResult.description:
BlockUserResult is the result of a block user call. Empty at the moment.
Centrifugo PRO only.

BoolValue.description:
BoolValue wraps a bool so that an unset value can be told apart from
false.

channels.description: channels is the list of channels to publish into. Required.

data.description:
data is the payload to publish into each channel. Required unless
b64data is set. In the HTTP API it is any JSON value; over GRPC it may
be binary.

b64data.description:
b64data is a base64-encoded binary payload, an alternative to `data` to
send binary over the HTTP API. Centrifugo decodes it before publishing.

skip_history.description: skip_history skips adding the publications to the channels' history.

tags.description:
tags is a map of arbitrary string keys and values attached to each
publication and delivered to clients.

idempotency_key.description:
idempotency_key drops duplicate publications upon retries. It acts per
channel; results are cached for 5 minutes.

delta.description:
delta tells Centrifugo to construct a delta update, if possible, when
broadcasting the publications to subscribers.

version.description:
version, when > 0, is the version of the document being sent:
publications with a version less than or equal to one already seen are
ignored. Only works in channels with history enabled.

version_epoch.description:
version_epoch is the epoch of version. When it changes, Centrifugo
accepts the publication even if its version is lower than before.

BroadcastRequest.description: BroadcastRequest publishes the same data into many channels.

error.description: error is set if the whole broadcast failed.

result.description: result is set on success. Check the error of each response in it.

BroadcastResponse.description: BroadcastResponse is the response to a BroadcastRequest.

responses.description:
responses is a publish response for each channel, in the order of
BroadcastRequest.channels. Each may carry its own error.

BroadcastResult.description: BroadcastResult is the result of a broadcast.

uid.description: uid is the uid of the push notification to cancel. Required.

CancelPushRequest.description:
CancelPushRequest cancels a delayed push notification (sent with
send_at). Centrifugo PRO only.

error.description: error is set if the call failed.

CancelPushResponse.description:
CancelPushResponse is the response to a CancelPushRequest.
Centrifugo PRO only.

CancelPushResult.description:
CancelPushResult is the result of a cancel push call. Empty at the
moment. Centrifugo PRO only.

source.description:
source is the source of the channel subscription (for example,
subscription token, subscribe proxy or server API).

ChannelContext.description:
ChannelContext is context of a channel subscription.
Centrifugo PRO only.

num_clients.description: num_clients is the number of connections subscribed to the channel.

ChannelInfo.description: ChannelInfo is information about an active channel.

pattern.description: pattern filters channels by name, using gobwas/glob syntax.

ChannelsRequest.description:
ChannelsRequest returns active channels (with one or more subscribers).
It can be heavy on large deployments: there is no pagination.

error.description: error is set if the call failed.

ChannelsResponse.description: ChannelsResponse is the response to a ChannelsRequest.

channels.description: channels maps channel name to information about the channel.

ChannelsResult.description: ChannelsResult is the result of a channels call.

broadcast.description: broadcast is a broadcast command, see BroadcastRequest.

subscribe.description: subscribe is a subscribe command, see SubscribeRequest.

Command.description:
Command is a single command inside a BatchRequest. Set exactly one of its
request fields; a command with none of them set gets a not found error.

app_name.description: app_name is the client application name, if provided by the client.

app_version.description:
app_version is the client application version, if provided by the
client.

transport.description: transport is the name of the connection transport.

protocol.description: protocol is the connection protocol: json or protobuf.

user.description: user is the user ID of the connection.

connected_at_ms.description:
connected_at_ms is the Unix time in milliseconds when the connection
was established.

ping_pong_latency_ms.description:
ping_pong_latency_ms is the last measured client ping/pong round-trip
latency in milliseconds. Can be -1 if not available.

labels.description: labels are the client labels attached to the connection.

ConnectionInfo.description:
ConnectionInfo is information about a client connection.
Centrifugo PRO only.

channels.description:
channels maps the channels the client is subscribed to to their
context.

connection_token.description: connection_token is information about the connection token.

subscription_tokens.description:

token used to subscribe to it.

meta.description:
meta is the meta information attached to the connection. It is not
visible to the client.

ConnectionState.description:
ConnectionState is the state of a client connection.
Centrifugo PRO only.

uid.description: uid is the unique token ID (jti claim).

issued_at.description: issued_at is the Unix time in seconds when the token was issued.

ConnectionTokenInfo.description:

Centrifugo PRO only.

expression.description: expression is a CEL expression to filter connections.

label_filter.description:
label_filter restricts the listing to clients whose labels match this
filter. Centrifugo PRO only.

error.description: error is set if the call failed.

ConnectionsResponse.description:
ConnectionsResponse is the response to a ConnectionsRequest.
Centrifugo PRO only.

connections.description: connections maps client ID to information about the connection.

ConnectionsResult.description:
ConnectionsResult is the result of a connections call.
Centrifugo PRO only.

users.description: users is the list of user IDs to delete the status for. Required.

DeleteUserStatusRequest.description: DeleteUserStatusRequest deletes the status of users. Centrifugo PRO only.

error.description: error is set if the call failed.

DeleteUserStatusResponse.description:
DeleteUserStatusResponse is the response to a DeleteUserStatusRequest.

DeleteUserStatusResult.description:
DeleteUserStatusResult is the result of a delete user status call. Empty

token.description:

user.description: user is the user associated with the device.

created_at.description:

updated_at.description:

meta.description: meta is the device meta. Only set if include_meta was requested.

topics.description:

webpush_keys.description:

SharedPollPublishRequest.description:
SharedPollPublishRequest pushes data for a key directly to clients of a
shared poll channel, without waiting for the next poll cycle. Requires
versioned mode and publish_enabled on the namespace.

error.description: error is set if the call failed.

SharedPollPublishResponse.description: SharedPollPublishResponse is the response to a SharedPollPublishRequest.

SharedPollPublishResult.description:
SharedPollPublishResult is the result of a shared poll publish call.
Empty at the moment.

offset.description: offset is the offset in the stream.

StreamPosition.description: StreamPosition is a position in a channel stream.

presence.description: presence overrides the presence channel option.

join_leave.description: join_leave overrides the join_leave channel option.

force_recovery.description: force_recovery overrides the force_recovery channel option.

force_positioning.description: force_positioning overrides the force_positioning channel option.

force_push_join_leave.description:
force_push_join_leave overrides the force_push_join_leave channel
option.

SubscribeOptionOverride.description:
SubscribeOptionOverride overrides channel options for a server-side
subscription. Unset fields keep the value from the channel configuration.

channel.description: channel is the name of the channel to subscribe to. Required.

user.description:
user is the ID of the user to subscribe. Required, unless all_users is
used in Centrifugo PRO.

expire_at.description: expire_at is the Unix time in seconds when the subscription expires.

info.description:
info is custom channel info attached to the subscription, used in
presence and join/leave messages.

b64info.description: b64info is info as base64, for binary. Centrifugo decodes it.

client.description:
client limits the call to the connection with this client ID. user is
still required.

data.description:
data is custom subscription data sent to the client in the Subscribe
push.

b64data.description: b64data is data as base64, for binary. Centrifugo decodes it.

recover_since.description: recover_since is the stream position to recover publications from.

override.description:
override dynamically overrides some channel options set in the
Centrifugo configuration.

session.description:
session limits the call to the connection with this session ID. user
is still required.

label_filter.description:
label_filter restricts the call to clients whose labels match this
filter. Centrifugo PRO only.

all_users.description:
all_users, when user is empty, targets every connection on every node
instead of the anonymous-only bucket. No effect when user is non-empty.
Without label_filter it acts on every connection. Centrifugo PRO only.

SubscribeRequest.description:
SubscribeRequest subscribes active sessions of a user to a channel
(server-side subscription). It does not create a streaming subscription
for the caller.

error.description: error is set if the call failed.

SubscribeResponse.description: SubscribeResponse is the response to a SubscribeRequest.

SubscribeResult.description: SubscribeResult is the result of a subscribe call. Empty at the moment.

uid.description: uid is the unique token ID (jti claim).

issued_at.description: issued_at is the Unix time in seconds when the token was issued.

SubscriptionTokenInfo.description:
SubscriptionTokenInfo is information about a subscription token.
Centrifugo PRO only.

user.description: user is the ID of the user to unblock. Required.

UnblockUserRequest.description: UnblockUserRequest unblocks a user. Centrifugo PRO only.

error.description: error is set if the call failed.

UnblockUserResponse.description:
UnblockUserResponse is the response to an UnblockUserRequest.
Centrifugo PRO only.

UnblockUserResult.description:
UnblockUserResult is the result of an unblock user call. Empty at the
moment. Centrifugo PRO only.

channel.description: channel is the name of the channel to unsubscribe from. Required.

user.description:
user is the ID of the user to unsubscribe. Required, unless all_users
is used in Centrifugo PRO.

client.description:
client limits the call to the connection with this client ID. user is
still required.

session.description:
session limits the call to the connection with this session ID. user
is still required.

label_filter.description:
label_filter restricts the call to clients whose labels match this
filter. Centrifugo PRO only.

all_users.description: all_users works as SubscribeRequest.all_users. Centrifugo PRO only.

UnsubscribeRequest.description: UnsubscribeRequest unsubscribes a user from a channel.

error.description: error is set if the call failed.

UnsubscribeResponse.description: UnsubscribeResponse is the response to an UnsubscribeRequest.

UnsubscribeResult.description:
UnsubscribeResult is the result of an unsubscribe call. Empty at the
moment.

analytics_uid.description:
analytics_uid is the analytics_uid of the push notification (as in
SendPushNotificationRequest). Required.

status.description:
status is the status of the push notification: delivered or
interacted. Required.

device_id.description: device_id is the Centrifugo device ID. Required.

msg_id.description: msg_id is the message ID issued by the provider.

UpdatePushStatusRequest.description:
UpdatePushStatusRequest saves the delivery or interaction status of a
push notification to analytics. Experimental. Centrifugo PRO only.

error.description: error is set if the call failed.

UpdatePushStatusResponse.description:
UpdatePushStatusResponse is the response to an UpdatePushStatusRequest.
Centrifugo PRO only.

UpdatePushStatusResult.description:
UpdatePushStatusResult is the result of an update push status call.
Empty at the moment. Centrifugo PRO only.

users.description: users is the list of user IDs to update the status for. Required.

state.description:
state is an optional custom state to store in the user status. It can
be restricted by the user_status.state_regex option.

UpdateUserStatusRequest.description:
UpdateUserStatusRequest marks users as active and online now, and sets
their state when one is given. Centrifugo PRO only.

error.description: error is set if the call failed.

UpdateUserStatusResponse.description:
UpdateUserStatusResponse is the response to an UpdateUserStatusRequest.
Centrifugo PRO only.

UpdateUserStatusResult.description:
UpdateUserStatusResult is the result of an update user status call. Empty
at the moment. Centrifugo PRO only.

active.description: active is the last active time as Unix seconds. Not set if unknown.

online.description:
online is the last online time as Unix seconds, updated by Centrifugo
while the user is connected. Not set if unknown.

state.description:
state is the custom state set with UpdateUserStatusRequest.state, if
any.

UserStatus.description: UserStatus is the status of a user. Centrifugo PRO only.

id.description: id is the ID of the user topic.

UserTopic.description: UserTopic is a topic subscription of a user. Centrifugo PRO only.

UserTopicFilter.description: UserTopicFilter selects user topic subscriptions. Centrifugo PRO only.

filter.description: filter selects the user topics to list.

include_total_count.description:
include_total_count includes the total count for the filter in the
result.

cursor.description:
cursor is the pagination cursor: next_cursor of the previous page,
empty for the first page.

limit.description: limit is the maximum number of items to return.

UserTopicListRequest.description:
UserTopicListRequest returns a paginated list of user topic
subscriptions. Centrifugo PRO only.

error.description: error is set if the call failed.

UserTopicListResponse.description:
UserTopicListResponse is the response to a UserTopicListRequest.
Centrifugo PRO only.

items.description: items are the user topics of this page.

next_cursor.description:
next_cursor is the cursor of the next page. Empty if there is no next
page.

total_count.description:
total_count is the total count for the filter, if include_total_count
was set.

UserTopicListResult.description:
UserTopicListResult is the result of a user topic list call.
Centrifugo PRO only.

user.description: user is the user ID. Required.

op.description: op is the operation: add, remove or set. Required.

topics.description: topics are the topics for the operation.

UserTopicUpdateRequest.description:
UserTopicUpdateRequest changes the topics of a user. The change is also
applied to the user's registered devices. Centrifugo PRO only.

error.description: error is set if the call failed.

UserTopicUpdateResponse.description:
UserTopicUpdateResponse is the response to a UserTopicUpdateRequest.
Centrifugo PRO only.

UserTopicUpdateResult.description:
UserTopicUpdateResult is the result of a user topic update call. Empty at
the moment. Centrifugo PRO only.

headers.description:
headers are Web Push HTTP headers. Recognized keys: TTL (seconds,
default 4 weeks), Urgency (very-low, low, normal, high) and Topic.

payload.description:
payload is the JSON payload delivered to the browser service worker.
Required.

WebPushPushNotification.description:
WebPushPushNotification is a notification for Web Push.
Centrifugo PRO only.

api.Disconnect.description: Disconnect describes the code and reason clients are disconnected with.
